claim: Let \(G=K_{3,4}\), let \(B_3(G)\) be the unordered configuration space of three distinct particles, and let \(W=\operatorname{Aut}(G)=S_3\times S_4\). Write \(\varepsilon_3\) and \(U_3\) for the sign and standard two-dimensional representations of \(S_3\); write \(\varepsilon_4\), \(V_4=S^{(3,1)}\), \(V'_4=S^{(2,1,1)}\), and \(M_4=S^{(2,2)}\) for rational irreducible \(S_4\)-representations. Then \[H_2(B_3(G);\mathbb Q)\cong_{\mathbb Q[W]}(\varepsilon_3\boxtimes(V_4\oplus V'_4\oplus 2M_4))\oplus(U_3\boxtimes(\varepsilon_4\oplus V_4\oplus V'_4\oplus M_4)).\] In particular the rational Betti vector is \((1,6,28,0)\), the 28-dimensional module contains exactly seven nonzero irreducible types with multiplicity two only for \(\varepsilon_3\boxtimes M_4\), and its space of \(W\)-invariants vanishes. The complete homology character on the 15 conjugacy classes is \((28,-2,4,-2,-2;-10,0,-2,2,0;1,1,1,-2,1)\), where the \(S_3\) cycle types are ordered \((1^3),(21),(3)\), and within each block the \(S_4\) types are \((1^4),(21^2),(2^2),(31),(4)\).
scientific_integrity: Complete finite equivariant chain computation; modular rank lower bounds joined to a geometric total-motion surjection to prove exact characteristic-zero dimensions.
scientific_limitations: Rational homology and abstract symmetry representation only; no integral torsion/splitting or higher-particle conclusion. Residual possibility of equivalent unindexed calculation.
title: The full \(S_3\times S_4\)-module on three-particle \(K_{3,4}\) configuration homology
